brief:
Ahmad Abd al-Karim al-Siqalli returned to Gaza following an Israeli airstrike that killed six of his children while he was in the West Bank, Shehab Wire reported. The strike targeted a house where his family had sought shelter after being displaced. Among those killed were an infant and three sets of twins.

His wife and one daughter survived the attack but sustained injuries. Al-Siqalli had received word of his children's deaths while away from Gaza, and has now returned to the territory amid the loss of half his immediate family in a single strike.
